verdict.rationale: x402 does have built-in event-triggered behavior (a 402 response automatically triggers a client to sign and retry payment, and batch settlement lets agents auto-settle vouchers after threshold events), but this is fixed protocol behavior, not a general rules engine where a user can define arbitrary conditions/actions. Missing for 10: user-configurable rule definitions, arbitrary event types beyond payment requests, and any dashboard/API for creating custom automation rules.
